families.name: AD / attack speed
families.slams: Bow, sword, Guinsoo's, Edge of Night

comps.name: Riftbeast Brambleback & Elder Dragon
comps.summary: The strongest comp on the patch, and it builds on Elder Dragon, your best carry.
comps.mustHave: Guinsoo's + Edge of Night on Brambleback. Without both, play Master Yi reroll instead.

items.build: Guinsoo's + Edge of Night (both required), then Hand of Justice. QSS or Sterak's also work
Protector's Vow, Adaptive Helm, mana-generating tank items

openers.name: Riftbeast opener
openers.board: 5 Riftbeast, with Akali or Camille holding items
openers.when: You see early Riftbeasts. At 5 Riftbeast, a shop full of Riftbeasts appears after every 3 combats, which helps you find Krug copies.

openers.name: Inferno AD opener
openers.board: Akali as item holder, plus Inferno units
openers.slam: Guinsoo's or Edge of Night on Akali
openers.when: You start with Inferno units. Burn and Wound are built in, so skip Sunfire, Morellonomicon and Red Buff.

openers.name: Rengar opener
openers.when: You get both items early. Hand them to Brambleback later. This also keeps Master Yi reroll open.

comps.tip: You play nearly the same units every game, so item quality decides your placement. Spend carousels and augments on finishing Brambleback's items.

comps.name: Master Yi reroll
comps.summary: Your backup when you have AD items but a weak start or no Edge of Night.
comps.mustHave: An artifact, a Brawler Emblem, or a Rengar no one else is building. It's the most-played top-tier comp (4.7%), so scout first.

items.build: AP Yi: Guinsoo's, Edge of Night, Titan's. AD Yi: QSS, Edge of Night, Titan's. Artifacts like Wit's End or Hellfire Hatchet are even better
Guinsoo's + Edge of Night (both required), Titan's
Gargoyle's, Warmog's, Spirit's. Krug takes leftover tank items

openers.name: Rengar opener
openers.board: Rengar as carry, plus whatever tanks you hit
openers.when: Early Rengar with bows or swords. Add a Brawler Emblem and you're locked into Yi–Rengar reroll.

openers.name: Blossom opener
openers.board: 3 Blossom: Yorick tanks, Master Yi in place of Karma
openers.when: A Yi drops from an orb or shows up early. Yorick stays as your early frontline.

comps.tip: This comp struggles from behind. Once Yi and a frontliner hit 3 stars, stop rolling, rebuild your gold and level. That's the econ habit your C grade is missing.

comps.name: Invoker Ahri flex
comps.summary: Your AP comp for strong starts. An Invoker Emblem on Ahri makes it one of the best comps in the game.
comps.mustHave: Lots of good AP items, and a path to level 9. Dying at 8 usually means 4th at best.

items.build: Invoker Emblem, Jeweled Gauntlet, Striker's, Shojin / Blue Buff, Nashor's
Void Staff, Morellonomicon / Red Buff, Deathcap
Void Staff, Morellonomicon / Red Buff, Shojin
Sett or Amumu: generic tank items. Sentinel or Lillia: Protector's Vow, Adaptive Helm

comps.augmentOrder: Items or emblems, then econ, then combat

leveling.label: Win streak
leveling.note: Low on HP at 4-2? Switch to Invoker Teemo.

openers.name: Blossom opener
openers.board: 3 Blossom: Yorick tanks, Karma holds AP items
openers.slam: Jeweled Gauntlet, Blue Buff or Striker's for Ahri. Void Staff or Shojin if you're win-streaking
openers.when: The most consistent opener in the set. Karma's items go to Ahri later, and Yorick hands off to Amumu.

openers.name: Azir variant
openers.board: 3 Blossom with Azir in place of Karma
openers.when: You have no 2-star Karma and no mana item.

comps.tip: Put Ahri on the same side as the enemy carry so she kills it before your frontline breaks. Karma or Pebbles holds her items until she arrives in stage 4.

comps.name: Invoker Teemo reroll
comps.summary: Your safety net. It rarely wins but usually lands top 4, which turns your 8ths into 4ths.
comps.mustHave: Jeweled Gauntlet + Shojin on Teemo, and early Teemo copies. Shares Morgana, Sentinel and AP items with Ahri.

items.build: Jeweled Gauntlet + Shojin (the minimum), Striker's third
Morellonomicon / Red Buff, Void Staff, leftover AP

openers.name: Teemo + Brawler opener
openers.board: Teemo with Brawler frontline: Alistar, Kobuko
openers.slam: Jeweled Gauntlet or Shojin on Teemo
openers.when: You hit 2+ Teemo copies early and have a rod or tear. Hold every Teemo and Alistar copy from 2-1 on.

openers.name: Blossom opener
openers.board: 3 Blossom (Karma, Yorick) while holding Teemo copies
openers.slam: Jeweled Gauntlet or Shojin on Karma
openers.when: Blossom is strong early, but your Teemo copies aren't there yet. Switch to Teemo at 3-2.

comps.tip: Your job is tempo and HP. Once Teemo is 3-star, stop rolling, level, and add Morgana 2 and Sentinel. Under 50 HP at 3-2 in an Ahri game? Move Ahri's items onto Teemo and reroll at 6.

pickSteps: Stage 2: your first item slam picks the family. Bow or Guinsoo's means AD. Rod, tear or Jeweled Gauntlet means AP.
Stage 3-2: check HP and streak. Healthy and winning means the fast 8 comp. Losing or under 60 HP means the reroll comp.
Scout at 3-2 and 4-1: if two or more players are building your comp, switch to the other comp in your family.

rules.title: No rolling below 50 gold before 4-2
rules.detail: Unless you're under 40 HP or playing a reroll comp at its roll timing.

rules.title: Under 50 HP at 4-1 on a fast 8 comp?
rules.detail: Roll at 8 for a stable board, or switch to the reroll comp in your family. Don't greed for 9.

rules.title: Scout at 3-2 and 4-1
rules.detail: If two or more players are building your carry, switch comps right away.

rules.title: Fight for 5th
rules.detail: A 5th instead of an 8th saves you about 40 LP. When you're dying, roll everything for the strongest board you can make.

rules.title: Stop after two bottom-4s in a row
rules.detail: Your –126 LP session on 14 Nov came from three bad games back to back.
